description:
Get details of a single webhook delivery attempt including request/response payloads and retry history.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_webhook_delivery

endpoint_id.description: The webhook endpoint it was sent to. Null for a request's `callback_url` and for a delivery to the account's settings webhook URL before the switch-over to endpoints.

event_type.description: Type of webhook event. `proof.suspended`/`proof.unsuspended` fire for a delegation (`ph_dlg_*`) lifecycle act on the account's own configured webhook_url — not a channel to a separately-addressed delegate (h-fix-delegation-suspend-governance).

payload.description: The event body as stored. Every `proof_token` in it is null: the body POSTed to the receiver carries the token, read from its record at send time, and delivery history keeps no copy.

profile_id.description: The sub-account whose event it was. Null for an account-level event, and for deliveries recorded before #421.

token_omitted_reason.description: Why the last send carried `proof_token: null`. Every attempt, the first included, sends the token the delivery was queued with, or null: a retried delivery carries the same `proof_token` as the first attempt or `proof_token: null`, never a different token. `source_gone`: the record holding the token no longer exists, or (for a delivery stored before tokens were left out of history) could not be identified. `token_absent`: it holds no token, or there was none when the delivery was queued. `token_changed`: its token is no longer the one the delivery was queued with (re-issued or changed since). Null when every token was sent. Absent from an API that predates it.
